name: The Unfinished Question
prompt: Grow a dark hedge in the form of an enormous loose question-mark curve with an isolated round topiary. Gardeners move small gates cut from the hedge to change which route reaches the dot. A picnic waits there beneath a yellow parasol.

name: The Hedge That Reads Your Shadow
prompt: Line parallel hedge corridors with tall hinged fins of green mesh. A visitor's shadow tells a gardener which fin to pivot, opening a new diagonal passage. Seen from above, the changing gaps resemble a flickering woven pattern.

name: A Maze of Low Tides
prompt: Cut paths between waist-high beds of silver marsh grass. Small sluices alternately flood and drain their junctions, leaving a changing network of dry stepping stones. One visitor consults a line of damp footprints as the next gate closes.

name: The Maze Goes to Market
prompt: Plant short hedge segments in red handcarts. Stallholders assemble them into a different market maze every morning. Viewed from above, one cart rolls away to reveal a bakery and three children take the newly opened shortcut.

name: The Stranger's Thread
prompt: Grow a tight spiral of dark yew with a single unruly lilac bush at its heart. Visitors run bright wool through low brass rings along their chosen shortcuts. The outer lawn carries the tangled coloured record of many different journeys.
